typography.weight_strategy: Sleeker, ultra-premium Poppins styling. Heavily avoid chunky/overly bold text. Use Light (300) and Regular (400) for large expressive displays and descriptions, Medium (500) for structural accents/buttons, and Semi-Bold (600) strictly for sub-titles or numerical focal points.

faq_section_specs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_section_specs.subtitle: Key insights for global decision-makers establishing or expanding GCC presence in India.

questions.question: What is the typical timeline from space identification to GCC occupancy in India?
questions.answer: Our integrated turnkey model reduces conventional delivery timelines by 30-40%. For standard 50,000 to 150,000 sq ft centres, design-build execution ranges between 14 to 20 weeks. Our pre-construction strategy addresses long-lead equipment procurement and Indian statutory approvals concurrently with early architectural design.

questions.question: How does Zyeta harmonize global corporate workplace guidelines with local Indian regulations?
questions.answer: We maintain strict compliance with global enterprise standards (fire/life safety, acoustic privacy, IT redundancy, ESG/LEED guidelines) while tailoring engineering execution to regional Indian building codes (NBC), state municipal clearances, landlord fit-out handovers, and local vendor ecosystems across Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, NCR, and Chennai.

questions.question: What sustainability and health certifications can Zyeta deliver for our India GCC?
questions.answer: Zyeta is a accredited studio across USGBC LEED (Platinum/Gold), IWBI WELL, and IGBC standards. We embed sustainable material sourcing, high-efficiency HVAC, energy analytics, and biophilic interior planning into every GCC project, delivering up to 35% operational energy cost reduction.

questions.question: How does Zyeta handle hybrid flexibility and rapid headcount expansion for new GCCs?
questions.answer: We design modular, reconfigurable spatial layouts with smart occupancy sensors, flexible micro-neighborhoods, and scalable MEP infrastructure. This allows GCCs to adjust density, convert workstation zones to collaborative innovation labs, and scale headcount seamlessly without disruptive re-fits.
